title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Gran Canaria summit, Las Palmas and Maspalomas grid points, 22–28 February 2015–2026
claims: For the summit query the archive returned the grid point 27.94376 N, 15.625702 W at 1,680 m elevation, covering 22–28 February in each year from 2015 to 2026, a total of 84 days.
At that summit grid point the daily maximum over the 84 days ranged from 5.8 to 22.7 °C with a median of 12.3 °C, and the daily minimum ranged from -1.9 to 12.0 °C with a median of 3.6 °C.
Precipitation at the summit grid point reached at least 1 mm on 23 of the 84 days and at least 5 mm on 9 days, with a maximum daily total of 76.3 mm.
The grid point is at 1,680 m, close to the track's 1,731 m high point, but it is a model grid cell rather than an on-course measurement.

The same archive API, queried for the Las Palmas start grid point (28.0844 N, 15.4576 W, 8 m), returned a daily maximum of 16.9–28.1 °C with a median of 19.3 °C, a daily minimum of 10.4–22.3 °C with a median of 15.0 °C, 28 wet days at 1 mm, 10 at 5 mm and a maximum daily total of 21.9 mm over 84 days.

The same archive API, queried for the Maspalomas finish grid point (27.8032 N, 15.5906 W, 44 m), returned a daily maximum of 17.6–29.4 °C with a median of 21.25 °C, a daily minimum of 12.4–22.8 °C with a median of 15.0 °C, 15 wet days at 1 mm, 5 at 5 mm and a maximum daily total of 52.8 mm over 84 days.
